text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On her day off, Kawakami Princess is

participating in an event announcing a
new TV
series in her favorite franchise.

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Here to show her support for the new
Princess
Fighter series, today we're
joined by Kawakami
Princess!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
So, Kawakami Princess, is it true that you
were
inspired by Princess Fighter to
enter the world of
racing?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I wanted to be beautiful,
graceful, and
courageous, just like the
princess in Princess
Fighter. ♪

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, could you tell us a
little about
your daily routine?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Certainly. Just like any princess, I start
every day
with a cup of morning tea.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And in the evening, after a long day of
training, I
relax by taking a rose petal
bath. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's just like they say in Princess Fighter:
"A
princess must continue to refine
herself every
day!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess doesn't seem nervous
at all
and is handling her TV appearance
with aplomb.
But all of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, what's that truck doing? Doesn't
it look
dangerous?!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Eeek! Watch out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear a commotion coming from the
roadside.
When I look over, I see a large
truck swerving
wildly towards the
sidewalk.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll take care of this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Everyone get back! I'll catch up to it in
no time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urrraaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You! Sleepyhead! Wake up and
pull yourself
together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm sorry I had to interrupt our
discussion
like that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Th-that was incredible, Kawakami
Princess! What
tremendous acceleration!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you very much! As you can
see, living
a princess lifestyle does
wonders for my physical
abilities! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For my morning tea, I do strength
training by
drinking from a giant, steel
tea cup! And at night,
I do 300 squats
before I take my rose petal bath!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess hones her body! A princess
has
powerful legs! These are the things I
learned from
Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
She's the real thing... She's Princess
Fighter in the
flesh!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Wow, she's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Tell us more! What other
training do
you do?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
A-all right, everyone, please calm down!
Don't
push the people ahead of you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uwahh?! Everyone is so worked up! I've
got kind
of a bad feeling about this...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what should I do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I understand! Stay composed... Act like
a
princess...
choice_data_list: 落ち着いて、姫らしくなだめてみるとか？
これもプリンセスパワーで解決だ！

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
E-everyone? Could you please mind
your
behavior a little m—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! HEEEY! I'm telling you to be quiet!
Listen!
To! What! I'm! Saying!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It takes quite some time for the
excitement
coursing through the venue
to settle. From this
day forward,
Kawakami Princess's fans grow even

more passionate!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
S-solve it with princess power? But...
how?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's just like they say in Princess Fighter:
"A
princess must always be full of spirit!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Kawakami Princess
walks over
to the grand piano prepared
at the side of the
stage, and stands
imposingly in front of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: DUN-DUUUUN!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
EVERYONE! Please quiet down! You're
causing an
inconvenience to those
around you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The force in her voice appears to stun
the crowd,
and the commotion suddenly
subsides!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You should mind your manners while in
the
presence of a princess! Promise me
you'll do that,
both for me and for
Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Kawakami Princess's scolding
of the
crowd, the rest of the event
concludes without a
hitch.
